summary: Julian 提出协议内 gas 期货，让用户与企业锁定未来手续费，缓解费用波动带来的体验问题。shemnon 把 Falcon 与 ML-DSA 后量子预编译加入 Glamsterdam 元 EIP 并合并。EF 密码学团队启动 L1 zkEVM 安全冲刺，三个里程碑与后续硬分叉挂钩。

items.title: ethresear.ch：论协议内 gas 期货
items.note: （Julian）17:16：gas 费波动造成糟糕体验，用户需预留资金应对费用飙升，企业也把费用波动纳入部署决策，文章探讨在协议内提供 gas 期货。
items.note_en: (Julian), 17:16: fee volatility hurts UX, forcing users to hold buffers for spikes and businesses to factor it into deployment choices, so the post explores gas futures inside the protocol.

three milestones for the L1 zkEVM security sprint
L2BEAT proposes a security council walkaway test
summary_en: Julian proposed in-protocol gas futures so users and businesses can lock in future fees and ease volatility. shemnon added the Falcon and ML-DSA post-quantum precompiles to the Glamsterdam meta EIP, merged. The EF cryptography team started an L1 zkEVM security sprint with three milestones tied to upcoming forks.
